newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cadia go-ahead lifts Newcrest shares.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cadia go-ahead lifts Newcrest shares.

text.p: Shares in gold miner Newcrest Mining jumped over two percent to an intraday high of A$4.70 in on Monday following the New South Wales government's approval of the Cadia Hill gold/copper mine.
The mine, costed at A$440 million, is located in central New South Wales.
The mine is forecast to become one of the five largest gold mines in Australia, and possibly the largest in New South Wales, processing more than 17 million tonnes of ore per year.
"The project approval has been a plus for them this mnorning," said a Sydney broker.
By 1.00 p.m. (0300 GMT), Newcrest shares were off their highs at A$4.65 but up five cents on Friday's close on turnover of 221,200 shares.
